prompt: Plastic waste has become a major environmental problem. What are the problems caused by plastic waste, and what solutions can be implemented?
essay:
In today’s world, people heavily rely on plastic products and packaging and  plastic waste has become the main contributing factor to environmental issues. The main concerns are pollution-related diseases and a reduction in the number of sea animals. This essay will discuss the potential problems and the feasible solutions for them.

Plastic waste can bring about a number of negative consequences on public health. One of the dire consequences of the over-consumption of single-use plastic is that it attracts flies and rodents to landfill sites. As they carry many pathogens, they can eventually lead to serious illness and diseases such as diarrhoea, leptospirosis and  cholera.  Secondly, it can partly contribute to water pollution. Having no place to be discarded, part of these wastes are thrown into the sea.This can lead to a hostile environment for aquatic life. The sea animals can get suffocated due to large plastic residues and even die in the worst case scenario.

To combat these issues, the first step is to reduce the consumption of non-disposable plastic products to the least. And if it is possible, plastic bags can be reused for different purposes. Additionally, recycling the plastic can substantially benefit the environment. For example, environmentalists recommend  reduce, reuse and recycle, which is also known as the three R approach. Moreover, it is essential to educate the public as most people are unaware of the negative impacts of plastic on the environment. By raising public awareness, it can also limit plastic consumption to a certain extent.

In conclusion, as plastic has become a major threat to the environment, it is imperative to reduce it as much as possible with public awareness and reduce-reuse-recycle policy.
